title: CONNECT-IP ROUTE_ADVERTISEMENT Capsule Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, and diff hygiene for RFC 9484 ROUTE_ADVERTISEMENT capsule behavior.
scope: This verification covers ROUTE_ADVERTISEMENT Type 0x03 and length encoding, IP Address Range field order, IP version/address/protocol validation, protocol-zero and ICMP semantics, malformed field handling, supersession and withdrawal semantics, ordered non-overlapping route validation, request-stream abort policy, validation permission, and extension-header protocol-number matching policy.
preconditions: RFC 9484 CONNECT-IP request and address-assignment support is implemented.
expected_result: The focused ROUTE_ADVERTISEMENT tests pass, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9484 ROUTE_ADVERTISEMENT artifacts, generated triage reflects requirements 0127-0149 as trace-clean, and diff hygiene passes.
status_summary: The RFC 9484 ROUTE_ADVERTISEMENT capsule surface is trace-owned and verified by focused local gates.
